# P34.34b — CI export-mode build + island budgets over a from-spine fixture export

**Requirement ids cited (context, not owned):** SIG-FIND-005 · SIG-UI-036…041 ·
SIG-UI-050 · SIG-ENG-040. DR-C4-13 is an agent draft (R10_PREVIEW §3.6/7/8), not
a spec id.
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/242_P34.34b__export-mode-ci-build-and-island-budgets.md`
(manifest row 242, Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Base:**
`r11/P34.34a-release-archive-link-depth-and-crawl` · **Gate:** none ·
**Live stage:** none (`live_verification=false`) ·
**Production mutations:** none · **OM-20:** not an OM-20 row ·
**CI config changed:** YES — the `web` job gains an export-mode leg
(H2 §4.7 disclosure; see below).

## Why

The P32.23a candidate's export-mode build failure (C4 NEW-26) showed that the
fixture-mode web CI can be green while `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export` over a real
from-spine export is broken — and nothing would have caught it before the
release candidate. DR-C4-13 (agent draft) requires the island/page budgets and
Lighthouse measured on a real-data-shaped build, including the Round-10 routes
(`/releases/`, `/research-dossier/`) and one archive record.

## What ships

- **From-spine fixture export** (`scripts/ci/build_from_spine_fixture_export.py`):
  stands up PG18+PostGIS in a testcontainer via the `tests/db/conftest.py`
  harness (loaded from file — `tests/db` is not a package, the
  `tests/e2e` pattern), deploys the real `db/sqitch.plan` (`--verify`),
  seeds the licence-safe fixture spine through the module-level
  `seed_export_spine` factored out of
  `tests/db/test_spine_export_over_seeded_spine.py` (one seed, proven by the
  existing suite — never a re-authoring), runs the real `run_spine_export`
  read-only snapshot, and `write_to`s the export directory. `--release`
  additionally runs `build_release` + `validate_release` (P34.34a's
  same-origin crawl included) so the archive record exists. A missing Docker
  daemon is a hard failure (exit 2), never a skip. No web fixture JSON is
  authored anywhere in this path (C4 NEW-26).
- **Export-mode leg** (`scripts/ci/export_mode_leg.sh`): one subcommand per CI
  step — `produce` → `verify-fail-loud` (an empty export dir MUST fail the
  build; runs before the real build so a half-written `dist/` can never be
  measured) → `build` (`SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export SIG_EXPORT_DIR=…
  SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1 npm run build`) → `mount-record` (the release
  builder's own record page bytes at the stable alias
  `dist/r/_fixture-record/index.html` — publication/entity ids are
  content-derived and differ every run) → `budgets`
  (`measure-island-budgets.mjs`, ADR-134 ceilings) → `lighthouse`
  (`lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.export.json`). `ci.yml` dispatches
  each subcommand as its own named step; `make check-export-mode`
  (reachable from `make ci-local`) runs the same driver — the
  CI↔ci-local parity invariant keeps holding.
- **`web/lighthouserc.export.json`**: the export-mode collect set — the base
  pages plus `/releases/`, `/research-dossier/` (built under
  `SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1`, still off the public allow-list) and
  `/r/_fixture-record/` — with the `assertMatrix` and `numberOfRuns` mirrored
  verbatim from `lighthouserc.json` (a budget relaxed only for export mode
  would be a hidden regression; the drift is test-enforced). The base
  `lighthouserc.json` also gains `/releases/` + `/research-dossier/` in its
  collect set (DR-C4-13).
- **Regression guard** (`tests/unit/test_ci_workflows.py`): the web job must
  invoke the leg subcommands in order (`produce` before `build`,
  `verify-fail-loud` before `build`); the leg must bind `SIG_EXPORT_DIR` to
  the producer's `--out` dir; neither the web job nor the leg may mention
  `export:fixtures`/`build-fixture-export`; the producer source must contain
  `run_spine_export` + `seed_export_spine` and never shell to npm/node; the
  export rc must carry the three new URLs and mirror the base assertMatrix.
  Removing the leg, or feeding it serialized web fixtures, turns the suite
  red (OM-15: invariants, never file lists).
- **Producer proof** (`tests/db/test_export_fixture_web_bundle.py`,
  Docker-gated): drives `produce()` over the suite container and asserts the
  written dir carries every artifact `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export` reads
  fail-loud (manifest, the ten P27.1 surfaces, `leverage.json`, the
  `web/analytics/*` family, per-compartment tiles + attribution), the
  licence gate held (UNDETERMINED subject excluded, ODbL compartment
  separate), the release emits ≥1 record page and `validate_release` is
  green, and the session stays read-only/uncommitted.

## CI change (H2 §4.7)

`web` job, after the existing fixture-mode `check:perf` step: pinned uv +
Python + `make sync`, then the six `export_mode_leg.sh` steps above. The
fixture-mode build, budgets and all existing legs are unchanged; the export
leg runs last so `web/dist` ends export-shaped. Runner time added: one
PostGIS container + sqitch deploy + one astro build + 3×lhci runs
(measured on the first CI run and recorded in the run ledger).
